meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 安装后，助手可通过 Signal 收发消息。它作为你现有手机号的辅助设备接入，无需新号码；用 Signal 扫描二维码完成绑定后，你就能用 Signal 私聊或群聊与助手对话，支持 Markdown 格式、引用回复等功能。
howto.when: 当你在 Signal 中向已绑定的号码发送消息时触发；新用户首次发消息需先获授权。

say.note: 验证 Signal 的文本格式

say.text: 回复我并引用我上一条消息
我发了一段语音，你收到了吗？
say.note: 语音附件会被识别为占位符

howto.what_en: After installation, the assistant can send and receive messages via Signal. It joins as a secondary device on your existing phone number—no new number needed. Scan a QR code with Signal to link, then chat via Signal DMs or groups.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you send a message to the linked Signal number. New users must be granted access before the assistant responds.

say_en.text: Reply with bold and italic text
Reply and quote my last message
I sent a voice message, did you get it?
